items.title: Surveillance, a Telegram campaign and a parliamentary petition. How "Ukrainska Pravda" is being put under pressure
items.summary: The editorial team at “Ukrainska Pravda” has reported being subjected to pressure over articles concerning Davyd Arakhamia, the SBU and the links between business groups and media campaigns.

items.title: Russian drone attack on Chernihiv injures 2 – City Military Administration
items.summary: Two people, a man and a woman, were injured in a Russian drone attack on Chernihiv, during which three explosions were heard in the city, Head of Chernihiv City Military Administration Dmytro Bryzhynsky has reported.

items.title: The controversial Ukrainian website deciding who counts as an enemy of state
items.summary: Over the past month, a Ukrainian website's decision to expose Italian lawmakers for their pro-Russian statements has sparked an international scandal.
